title: Recording: Tango All Night by Ringo Starr | 1977
content:
Atlantic Studios, New York City
Producer: Arif Mardin
Engineer: Lew Hahn

Ringo Starr began recording ‘Tango All Night’ for his sixth studio album, Ringo The 4th, on 12 January 1977.

Written by Steve Hague and Tom Seufert from US band La Seine, ‘Tango All Night’ was issued as a single in 1978 in Argentina, with ‘It’s No Secret’ on the b-side. In Australia it was the b-side of the ‘Sneaking Sally Through The Alley’ single, released in 1977.
